title: solanum kitivuense subsp. englerianum
intro: Solanum kitivuense subsp. englerianum, commonly known as a plant species within the Solanaceae family, is a type of wild potato or a closely related plant. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Solanum kitivuense subsp. englerianum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing swelling and pain, and its antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycoalkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
